x-adcp-extension.description: Lets the buyer pre-authorize the seller to add zero-cost replacement units when the seller misses a deliverable or under-delivers, within a cap, a time window, and sameness rules (such as the same creator, platform, or creative format). A unit the seller adds under a rule is an ordinary core package with budget 0; this extension records why it exists and lets the buyer check that it stayed inside the rule. Anything outside a rule is a seller offer (core offer lane), not a make-good unit.

extends.semantics: Readback of the make-good units the seller issued under the rules, each pointing at its zero-cost core package. Same uri@digest as the accepted rules.

The buyer asks the seller to issue a make-good unit under an accepted rule for a missed deliverable. The seller answers accepted, with the zero-cost package that carries the unit, or rejected, with a reason.
